name: Reconciliation Flag 2
definition: Specifies the process type used for the trade repository reconciliation.

ReportType.name: Report Type
ReportType.definition: Indicates whether both counterparties to the transaction have reported to the same Trade Repository

BothCounterpartiesReporting.name: Both Counterparties Reporting
BothCounterpartiesReporting.definition: Indicates whether both counterparties are obliged to report the transaction data.

PairedStatus.name: Paired Status
PairedStatus.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is paired.

LoanReconciliationStatus.name: Loan Reconciliation Status
LoanReconciliationStatus.definition: Indicates whether loan data is reconciled.

CollateralReconciliationStatus.name: Collateral Reconciliation Status
CollateralReconciliationStatus.definition: Indicates whether collateral data is reconciled.

ModificationStatus.name: Modification Status
ModificationStatus.definition: Indicates whether the initially submitted report was further modified using action type modification.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/ReportType Must be present| Or	/BothCounterpartiesReporting Must be present| Or	/PairedStatus Must be present| Or	/LoanReconciliationStatus Must be present| Or /CollateralReconciliationStatus Must be present| Or /ModificationStatus Must be present
